courses.overview: 從封包交換、分層協議與歷史遷移延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend packet switching, layered protocols and historical transitions to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 全球資訊網早期伺服器系統
related.titleEn: Early World Wide Web server systems
related.why: 網際網路連通支撐後來的 Web
related.whyEn: Internet connectivity supports later Web systems
related.transfer: 網際網路連通支撐後來的 Web
related.transferEn: Internet connectivity supports later Web systems
related.difference: ARPANET/網路與 Web/應用不是同一層
related.differenceEn: ARPANET/network and Web/application are different layers

place.name: CERN 科學運算城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「全球資訊網早期伺服器系統」共用的資料／元件介面；以「網際網路連通支撐後來的 Web」指出能保留的條件。
針對「ARPANET/網路與 Web/應用不是同一層」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with early world wide web server systems; use "Internet connectivity supports later Web systems" to identify retained conditions.
For "ARPANET/network and Web/application are different layers", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: Internet 根網域伺服器系統
related.why: 共同利用分散網路與協議互通
related.whyEn: Both use distributed networks and protocol interoperability
related.transfer: 共同利用分散網路與協議互通
related.transferEn: Both use distributed networks and protocol interoperability
related.difference: DNS 根系統處理名稱委派而非資料路由
related.differenceEn: DNS roots delegate names rather than route data

courses.summary: ARPANET 歷史網路架構從封包交換、分層協議與歷史遷移連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: ARPANET historical network architecture connects interfaces, data and acceptance through packet switching, layered protocols and historical transitions. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「歷史證據」到「歷史報告」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect historical evidence to historical report, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 網際網路先驅回顧與 RFC 801 提供演進與遷移證據；課程區分 ARPANET、Internet 和 Web。
history.textEn: Internet-pioneer accounts and RFC 801 document evolution and transition; the course distinguishes ARPANET, Internet and Web.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.

roles.role: ARPANET IMP 的建造者 BBN 現屬 RTX（Raytheon）。
roles.roleEn: BBN, builder of the ARPANET IMPs, is now part of RTX (Raytheon).
roles.business: 航太國防集團（Raytheon、Collins、Pratt & Whitney），併入 BBN 等網路研究傳統。
roles.businessEn: Aerospace and defence group (Raytheon, Collins, Pratt & Whitney) that absorbed BBN’s networking heritage.

roles.role: IMP 以 Honeywell DDP-516 小型電腦為硬體基礎（歷史關聯）。
roles.roleEn: The IMPs were built on Honeywell DDP-516 minicomputers (historical association).
roles.business: 工業自動化與建築科技集團，為 Quantinuum 最大表決權股東。
roles.businessEn: Industrial-automation and building-technology group and the largest voting holder of Quantinuum.

courses.connection: 從「ARPANET 歷史網路架構」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in ARPANET historical network architecture. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.

vendors.name: RTX（雷神）
vendors.business: 航太與國防系統，含主動相位陣列雷達。
vendors.businessEn: Aerospace and defence systems including active phased-array radars.

vendors.name: 漢威聯合
vendors.business: 航太導航感測器與慣性參考系統，包含環形雷射陀螺儀與慣性量測單元。
vendors.businessEn: Aerospace navigation sensors and inertial reference systems, including ring-laser gyroscopes and inertial measurement units.
